thresholdEvidence.notes: American Whitewater documents the 3.3-mile Class II–III bypass and 1,500 cfs runnable context; FirstLight evaluates 2,500–13,000 cfs. The card uses a conservative 1,500 cfs floor and 2,500–8,000 cfs preferred band; this is not a safety guarantee.

endpointAudit.notes: Fishway/Discovery Center carry put-in and Poplar Street take-out coordinates come from FirstLight/settlement and American Whitewater; Poplar is a steep landing.

qualityControls.camping: nearby_basecamp at Barton Cove; no riverbank camping
qualityControls.access: fishway carry and Poplar take-out documented; Cabot Woods excluded as bypass put-in
qualityControls.duplicateReview: new river/endpoint pair; no duplicate Massachusetts route
